newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.006pts to 100.526.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.006pts to 100.526.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.006 points in Wednesday's trading to 100.526, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.552 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 96.729 points, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.328 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.013 points to 1,152.144.
